# Sysctl

The behaviors that sysctl calls, and each call that its examples make.
`osapi dsl chain get --name sysctl` shows the same.

## Chain

|          |                                                                    |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Behavior | [sysctl](../../behaviors/config/sysctl/sysctl.md)                  |
| Chain    | sysctl → managedfile                                               |
| Calls    | [managedfile](../../behaviors/internal/managedfile/managedfile.md) |
| Used by  | none                                                               |
